items.q: What areas does The Rock Guy TX deliver to?
items.a: We serve the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex and surrounding Texas communities, and we deliver to Arkansas and Oklahoma for larger projects. Request a quote with your delivery address and we will confirm availability and freight.

items.q: Do you sell bulk rock, sand, soil and mulch?
items.a: Yes. We sell crushed limestone, flex base, gravel, river rock, sand, topsoil, fill dirt, pit run, mulch and compost in bulk. Pricing is by the ton or cubic yard depending on the material.
Delivery depends on the material, quantity and distance from the yard. Use the quote form or call 817-454-5779 and we will give you a delivered price.

items.q: How do I figure out how much material I need?
items.a: Use the calculator on our quote page. Enter length, width and depth and it estimates cubic yards and tons. A common rule is that one ton of crushed rock covers about 100 square feet at 2 inches deep.
We serve contractors, landscapers, builders, municipalities and homeowners. Bulk pricing is available for repeat and high-volume customers.

items.q: Do you have a Fort Worth location?
items.a: Yes. Our new Fort Worth limestone pit carries 57 rock, 67 rock, flex base, base, 1–2" and oversize. Grand-opening pricing on 3/4" and 1-1/2" limestone is $17.50 per ton, pickup only, 500-ton minimum, through October 31, 2026. Message us for current pricing.
Many local orders can be scheduled quickly. Send your request with your preferred date and we will confirm the earliest slot.

items.q: What forms of payment do you accept?
items.a: Contact us for current payment options and commercial account setup.
